definitions: A person who is currently next in line to inherit a title or property, but whose claim can be superseded by the birth of a more closely related or legally recognized heir.
Someone expected to inherit but whose position is not legally guaranteed against a future, more direct claimant.
examples: The duke's nephew was the heir presumptive until a son was born.
She was the heir presumptive to the throne before her cousin had a child.
The company's vice president was considered the heir presumptive to the CEO.
